tools.name: info
tools.description: Free: prices in sats per product and period, nameservers, limits, record types, accepted Cashu mints, how paying works, and the steps to host a zone.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Free: runs the checks a paid call runs before payment (name rules, availability, delegation, limits) without creating an invoice, and returns the price. For zone_create and secondary_create of a new zone it answers delegation_missing with the zone's own nameserver pair (expected_ns) and an ns_ticket

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Free: whether a domain name is available and its price in sats (offered TLDs and live 1-year prices per TLD: info, domains.tlds and domains.prices). Tightly rate-limited. If the answer carries a registry notice (tld_notice), show it to your user before they pay.

tools.name: zone_create
tools.description: Creates a hosted, DNSSEC-signed zone on our nameservers. First call check (tool zone_create): a new zone gets its own nameserver pair, which must be set at the registrar before the payment step; pass the ns_ticket from that answer. tools.name: secondary_create
tools.description: We serve your zone as secondaries, transferred from your primaries (public IPv4) with a TSIG key that the answer gives once. tools.description: Creates a dynamic hostname such as myhome.dynkite.com. The answer gives the hostname token once (keep it: hostname_update and routers use it). tools.name: renew
tools.description: Extends a hosted zone, secondary zone or dynamic hostname by 30d or 1y from its current expiry. Needs no token: anyone may pay to extend any name. Paid, no account. tools.name: zone_add_queries

Authorize with the domain token (jdd_...), an api_key whose scope covers the domain, or nip98. Called without nip98 it returns signature_required: the exact URL, method and b

tools.description: Registers a domain for the registrant your user names. tools.name: domain_transfer
tools.description: Transfers a domain from another registrar (adds a year). The current registrar may take 5-7 days; domain_status shows progress. Keep the domain token (jdd_) secret, and keep the payment proof you used (the l402 value or the cashu token): calling again with the same arguments and proof within 24 h sh

tools.name: domain_renew

Paid, no account: without payment it answers payment_required with this order's price (valid 15 minutes), a Lightning invoice (L402) and a Cashu request,

tools.name: domain_token_recover
tools.description: Free: replaces a lost domain token using the l402 proof or cashu token the domain's registration or transfer was paid with. The old token stops working. Works while the domain is registered here, unless an account owns it (its owner uses token_rotate) or the registrant changed since.

tools.name: domain_token_email
tools.description: Free: without code, sends a one-time code to the registrant email of a domain no account owns (the answer is the same whether or not it qualifies); with code, replaces the domain token. The code works once, for 60 minutes. Ask your user for the code; never guess it.

tools.name: domain_refund
tools.description: Free: claims the refund of a domain order made without an account that failed after payment, with its payment proof (l402 or cashu), within 30 days. Checked at once; paid by hand over Lightning to destination. Completed orders are final.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: records_list, account_objects, account_order, order_status, claim, token_rotate, domain_status, domain_nameservers, domain_dnssec_sync · Private data: info, check, zone_create, secondary_create, hostname_create, renew, zone_add_queries, zone_status, records_list, records_change, dnssec_info, hostname_status, hostname_update, hostname_reminders, renewal_address, account_objects, account_order, order_status, claim, token_rotate, domain_status, domain_nameservers, domain_dnssec_sync, domain_register, domain_transfer, domain_renew, domain_token_recover, domain_token_email · Public sink: domain_status, domain_token_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: records_list, account_objects, account_order, order_status, claim, token_rotate, domain_status, domain_nameservers, domain_dnssec_sync · Private data: info, check, zone_create, secondary_create, hostname_create, renew, zone_add_queries, zone_status, records_list, records_change, dnssec_info, hostname_status, hostname_update, hostname_reminders, renewal_address, account_objects, account_order, order_status, claim, token_rotate, domain_status, domain_nameservers, domain_dnssec_sync, domain_register, domain_transfer, domain_renew, domain_token_recover, domain_token_email · Public sink: domain_status, domain_token_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
